notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds are governmental (School Nutrition is a special revenue fund inside Other Governmental Funds), so business_type is null. Top-level figures are from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4), Total Governmental Funds column. beginning_cash = fund balance beginning of year 65,495,960 and ending_cash = fund balance end of year 93,654,468 (equals total assets on p3: cash 14,083,350 + County Treasurer 11,458,396 + investments 68,112,722); investments are not added separately. Identity: 65,495,960 + 173,701,223 - 168,199,266 + 5,497,365 - 5,497,365 + 20,120,000 (bond issuance) + 2,536,551 (bond premium) = 93,654,468. Statement 'Interest' line prints a dash in all columns; interest is inside Local receipts (p2 Statement of Activities prints Interest income 1,754,823). Local receipts (46,817,144) split using the fund schedules' local lines (property tax, motor vehicle, carline, interest, license fees, fines, private grants, SPED tuition) plus Activity Fund receipts 2,653,067 (p15, new in this trim) and a 51,100 residual marked review; pieces sum exactly to 46,817,144. County receipts 1,398,864 split by fund column: 893,334 = General Fund 2110 county fines and license fees (fines and forfeitures) and 505,530 Other Governmental column (equals Qualified Capital Purpose state sources). 'Other' 724,871 (Other Governmental) kept as printed with review; Other Governmental receipts exceed the sum of its fund schedules (excluding transfers) by 546,814, equal to the Cooperative Fund disbursement, and the Cooperative fund balance analysis (739,597 = 711,935 + 27,662) shows the disbursement was offset, so the unexplained piece is probably a reimbursement. Debt service is one line (principal and interest combined). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis, Governmental Activities column (no total primary government column; component unit Central Nebraska Education Agency excluded). Detail: General Fund budgetary comparison (pp5-7, report pp29-31) and the other fund budget schedules pp8-16; the statement's General Fund column also includes the Depreciation, Employee Benefit and Contingency funds (153,232,251+254,168+151,102+51,092 = 153,688,613 receipts incl. transfer excluded; disbursements 129,422,371+433,928+14,232 = 129,870,531 ties). Transfer cross-check: General Fund 8000 transfers 5,497,365 = Depreciation 4,000,000 + School Nutrition 600,000 + Activities 897,365, all shown as transfers; no hidden transfers inside spending (General disbursements tie to the statement with no eliminations). Activities Fund has only the one-line budget schedule (p15, Original Budget column), recorded as printed. Detail disbursement lines are by program code with no object breakdown, so not itemized; zero-actual lines kept with budget. Read pages 1-16 of 16
